title: Switching display keeps the same tab, search, filters and work orders
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards" and "Jenny Wilson"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. three work orders for the customer "ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge" led by Esther Howard, Ralph Edwards and nobody, plus one for "ZZAUTOTEST Fisquare"):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. Click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge.
  4. Open the Status filter, tick the status your test work orders have (e.g. Estimate) and close the filter.
  5. In List, write down every work order number shown (e.g. S1-702, S1-691, S1-352: 3 rows).
  6. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  7. Write down the work order numbers shown and each group header count.
  8. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  9. Write down the work order numbers on the cards and each column header count.
  10. In the display switcher, click List (in the design its tooltip reads "Table").
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The layout changes straight away on each click, without a page reload.
  • After every switch the All tab is still selected, the search box still reads ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge and the Status filter still shows the status you ticked.
  • The same work orders appear in all three displays. With the example data: List shows 3 rows, Tech View shows the same 3 (Unassigned 1 + Esther Howard 1 + Ralph Edwards 1 = 3) and Board View shows the same 3 cards. The ZZAUTOTEST Fisquare work order appears in none of them.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R3, Feature Overview, read 8 Oct 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R3: “Switching display options immediately re-lays out the current results without changing the filter view, search text, or filters.”
  • Feature Overview: “The existing filter views (the tabs on the left — All, Work Orders, Estimates, Completed) and the filter bar (search, status, assigned to me, and so on) apply the same way in every display option.”
